atomicity_mechanism: Single conditional INSERT...SELECT...WHERE statement — SQLite executes the entire statement atomically as one implicit transaction. The subquery COUNT and INSERT are indivisible.
sql_pattern: INSERT INTO planner_invocations (...) SELECT ... WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM planner_invocations WHERE goal_id = ? AND invocation_kind = 'evaluator') < ?
before_fix: TOCTOU race: count_durable_evaluator_invocations() (plain SELECT) then later call_adapter() INSERT. UNIQUE(invocation_id) cannot prevent two different UUIDs from both passing the count check.
after_fix: reserve_evaluator_slot() uses a single atomic INSERT...SELECT...WHERE. If rows_affected() == 0, budget is exhausted. No separate SELECT needed.
restart_safety: PASS — durable rows survive, atomic reservation correctly reads existing count
per_goal_isolation: PASS — goal A exhaustion does not affect goal B
sequential_3_attempts_limit_2: PASS — third attempt correctly returns BudgetExhausted
no_explicit_transaction_needed: SQLite guarantees atomicity of single top-level INSERT...SELECT statements
